title: Persson Lists Beverly Hills Mansion: asks $70 million again; ultra-luxury LA market cools
summary_full: Markus Persson, the mastermind behind Minecraft, is putting his lavish Beverly Hills mansion on the market for $70 million. This expansive property boasts eight bedrooms and 15 bathrooms, along with one-of-a-kind features like a candy room and a nightclub. Acquired in December 2014 after selling Mojang to Microsoft, this listing highlights both the opulence of the home and the difficulties of navigating the high-end Los Angeles real estate landscape.
